**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What I checked

- **The refresh merge (head 4eb577be3).** `git show --remerge-diff` on the merge commit shows three deletions only: the conflict markers in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. Both sides stayed: `mod lathe_view;` (line 115) and `mod camera_target;` with its comment (line 117). A comparison of the `mod` lines against `origin/main` shows no dropped module in `crates/ui/src/lib.rs` or `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. The `catalog_filters` module (main, line 119) was added to main after 17a8c6e76; the merge did not lose it.
- **Trial merge with current main (a277dd9d5).** Clean, no conflicts. GitHub reports `mergeable: true`.
- **Display only, no leak.** `ViewFrame` and `view_frame` appear only in `crates/ui` (lib.rs, view_frame.rs, viewport.rs, egui_app/shell.rs, tests). A search of `crates/app`, `crates/post`, `crates/sim`, `crates/motion`, `crates/geometry`, `crates/cl` and `crates/tools` finds no reader. No machine file, envelope data, post script or golden changed. The envelope still measures the Z travel -197 to 3 (test assertion in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/lathe_view.rs`).
- **One basis by construction.** `mvp` (viewport.rs:1386), `ray_through` (:1127) and `dolly_cursor` (:1183) build from `eye`, `basis_right` and `basis_up`; all three map through the frame. `toward` converts the cube's world direction once, to local (`viewport.rs:1289-1291`). `basis_right`'s pole guard maps its result back through the frame (:1369). `pan` adds the Z part of right (:1104); on a mill that part stays 0, so the mill path is unchanged.
- **The frame is a proper rotation.** Local x = world -Z, y = +Y, z = +X; determinant +1, and x cross y = z. `with_frame(Mill)` equals the old house isometric (yaw 0.9, pitch 0.5, `viewport.rs:1241-1244`), so `state.rs:3909` and `:3923` keep the mill framing as before.
- **Command law.** The frame change is view state. `view_frame::sync` (shell.rs:286) writes `cam` only, and `lathe_view.rs` asserts the history cannot-undo state does not change.
- **Laws and form.** New modules carry provenance lines (`view_frame.rs:1-11`, `lathe_view.rs:1-7`). Decision record `docs/decisions/1993-lathe-envelope-axis.md` has what/why/dropped. The fixing commit ends `Fixes #1993`. The body has a `Changelog:` line. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in new non-test code. No new dependency, no process file, no build.rs or workflow change. No PNG under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots` is touched. `view_frame.rs` is 87 lines.

## Gate results (merged with main a277dd9d5, built locally in the review worktree)

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui` lib, filters lathe_view, camera_target, view_frame, work_envelope | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib, filters structural, machine_page, viewcube, eye_geom, view_names, orbit, pan, one_pick_rule, frame | 98 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed |
| `gpu_render` test binary (non-ignored) | 11 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The `gpu_render` change is one field on the ignored docs-images golden (release lane, `crates/ui/tests/gpu_render.rs:658`); it is compile-checked, not run.

## Requested changes

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- #2019 stays open for the gizmo, the mill-turn frame and the lathe cube face names. This PR states that split in its body and in the decision file. Good.
- PR #1689 also touches `Camera::eye`; the overlap named in the body may still bring a small merge conflict at merge time. The planner will class it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
